stageChange: Bar color only: VMC age/metallicity population mixture and one global RGB grade.

stageEvidence.source: Mazzi et al. 2021 VMC XLIII, released JKs regional histories; BC03 native-Z Johnson BVR spectra.
stageEvidence.selection: Regional centres inside the fixed two-sigma Kacharov bar ellipse. Ages >=10^8.6 years form the intermediate/old bar; younger light stays in the existing young populations.
stageEvidence.assumptions: Linear-age interpolation within published AMR edges and between regional young/old shifts. Scaled-solar Fe/H-to-Z conversion and BC03 log-age/log-Z interpolation are a color-prior proxy, not a reproduction of the VMC PARSEC/Kroupa synthesis. No metallicity extrapolation.
stageEvidence.limits: Regional histories are coarse and coupled to reddening and distance. Oldest age-bin labels extend beyond the cosmological age. Unsupported low-Z portions are omitted and disclosed. No formal color uncertainty is claimed.
